messages:
alejandra: Quick plan for a small pricing experiment next week: tighten tier names, refresh top FAQ bullets, and ship a micro calculator on /pricing. no big launch, staged posts + a short webinar.

rachel: agree. limit FAQ to 6 Qs, use use-case-first answers. i'll draft.

sam: KPIs: pricing->signup, calculator_use, and leads flagged enterprise-interest.

dom: tier-name suggestion: Developer / Production / Enterprise — clearer for eng buyers.

mike: will build tiny React estimator. need JSON payload spec and microcopy.

beth_cs: CS can auto-tag Dedicated/Private selections as enterprise-interest and route to Zendesk. need final field list Thu EOD.

nina: legal needs anonymized benchmark line if we mention cost savings. sam to share numbers.

rachel: webinar: 20m demo + 10m Q&A on Thu 2/16. i'll write signup copy and banner CTA.

sam: sharing bench doc today; wording will be "GPU-optimized serving" to avoid infra details.

alejandra: owners: copy=rachel, calc=mike, blog=dom, CS routing=beth_cs, legal=nina, webinar=sam. Wed 10am check-in.

mike: proto payload: {"monthly_tokens":50000,"commitment":"none","tier":"Developer"} — i'll pair Wed AM for microcopy.

alejandra: run A/B on tier names for 3 weeks, instrument events: pricing_page_view, calc_open, calc_submit, lead_tagged.

rachel: draft ready Wed AM, pairing confirmed.
